hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Flop — Jack, 6, King. You bet. Your opponent raised you back.
River — Jack. Your opponent shoved all-in without hesitation.

wrongReasons: J 10 is close, but the river lead is the tell. The correct hand picked up more on the river than J 10 would have.
6 6 makes a full house here — a hand that strong would have raised earlier and pushed harder for maximum value. The measured sizing in this hand points to something weaker.
5 Q has little reason to lead the river here — one pair can't comfortably go for value after calling two streets.
hand.explanation:
Answer: J A

Your opponent flopped three of a kind and raised the flop immediately to build the pot. Sets are too strong to slow-play — they pushed their advantage on every street.
